name: SDN Epoch State
description: TLE-to-numerical handoff (Evidence-Supported ASO Catalog, section 5): evaluates each $MPE (derive) or $OMM (derive_omm) element set with SGP4 at zero elapsed time, or at the epoch plus the ages of the options frame, transforms the TEME state to GCRF at the same instant (IAU 2006/2000A via ERFA, velocity including the frame rotation rate), verifies the round trip, and emits one $OEM per element set with its lineage and initial-condition uncertainty marked unknown. answer_propagation_requests plugs SGP4 into the propagator query port of analysis/maneuver-detection. Pure compute; output bytes depend only on input bytes.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each element set is evaluated independently in one bounded pass; the module starts no workers. Hosts parallelize by invoking separate instances on separate batches.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $MPE stream: concatenated [u32le length][$MPE buffer] frames; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is Unix seconds (UTC).
JSON {"ages": [days, ...]}: one row per age, SGP4 evaluated at the element set's epoch plus the age (forward only, 0 to 400 days). Absent: the epoch state alone.

wildcardJustification.detail: Rows to evaluate. Control metadata only; no observations encoded here.

inputPorts.description: JSON {"ages": [days, ...]}: one row per age, SGP4 evaluated at the element set's epoch plus the age (forward only, 0 to 400 days). Absent: the epoch state alone.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $OEM stream, one single-row OEM (GCRF, UTC, km and km/s) per derived element set, in input order.

outputPorts.description: Derived epoch states. Absent when no element set could be derived.

acceptedTypeSets.description: JSON: record, derived and failed counts, epochs outside the leap-second table, maximum round-trip residuals, and the refused element sets by input index with the reason and SGP4 error code.

wildcardJustification.detail: Run accounting for the derivation. Diagnostic metadata, never persisted as an observation.

methods.description: Derives one GCRF epoch state per $MPE element set (and, with options.ages, the states at the epoch plus each age). Refused element sets (theory other than SGP4, non-finite or invalid elements, SGP4 errors, round trip outside tolerance) are listed in the report and produce no OEM.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $OMM element sets, concatenated; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is ISO 8601 UTC. The object is NORAD_CAT_ID, else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM element sets, concatenated; zero-length prefixes are padding. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY must be SGP4; EPOCH is ISO 8601 UTC. The object is NORAD_CAT_ID, else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME.

outputPorts.description: Derived epoch states. Absent when no element set could be derived.
